production.selection: Group4 only MODE0,N31/N32,S=clog2N; original binary fallback for all other configurations. No interface/parameter/pipeline change.

retained.dyn_left_shifter: Original; native/descending alternatives had cross-part timing regressions.
retained.dyn_right_shifter: Original; no robust timing gain across zero/custom fill and real packer SW5.

production.qualification: Both parts: three matched implementation strategies, positive leaf timing, N32 >=5% median matched gain, N31 normalization chain >=5% median matched gain, no matched-strategy slowdown and <=10% LUT growth. N31 A35 leaf-only gain is3.83%, not a standalone >=5% material win.

unit.scope: Binary exhaustive small widths, all shift encodings, directed/random large widths; no X/Z equivalence claim

limitations: STA estimates and abstract LOD-shift chains, not full-MAC Fmax or board signoff.
Do not infer native12 SAC timing from the SW+1 benchmark: selected native12 activates only SW4.
L1 arithmetic and previously frozen numerical checkpoints unchanged; current implementation source hash is a new checkpoint.

integration.scope: Integration smoke after bit-exact primitive source replacement, not a new full 10M MAC acceptance or full-MAC timing measurement.

predeclared_review: Timing-first: >=5% median STA gain, <=10% physical LUT growth, identical declared RTL boundary banks, nonnegative hold. Report physical FF changes and verify netlist function/latency. Confirm worst-case behavior and chains on both parts. No threshold tuning; floating point comparisons use only roundoff epsilon.
limitations: STA-derived estimates, not swept Fmax or on-board measurements.
Default/Explore/Runtime are strategies, not independent random placement seeds.
Identical declared boundary banks; implementation may replicate/merge FF. Report physical FF changes; inspect netlist before promotion.
Synthetic OOC I/O delays, no board pins; assess R2R and I/O separately.
No new pipeline or numeric changes. No whole-MAC speedup inferred.

netlist_verification.scope: Functional post-route default-strategy netlists and declared two-bank latency; no SDF timing simulation.
